metadata.title: HOME360 · Home services with a real guarantee
metadata.description: Home services. With a real guarantee. AI diagnosis, protected payments and five guarantee options back every visit to your home.

header.menuDescription: Page sections, sign in and registration.

hero.title: The only place you can hand over your house key with *complete peace of mind.*
hero.subtitle: We connect homes with verified businesses: AI diagnoses the problem, the payment stays protected until the job is done, and every service is backed by a real guarantee.

heroVisual.alt: A HOME360 service journey: the photo of the problem moves to the AI diagnosis and from there to the protected payment.

features.title: Home service that can actually be *audited.*
features.subtitle: Three pieces that change the conversation between customer and business: what will be done, what it costs and who answers if something goes wrong.

aiDiagnosis.title: AI diagnosis
aiDiagnosis.description: The customer uploads a photo and the AI describes the likely fault, the materials and the price range before anyone sets foot in the house.

protectedPayments.title: Protected payments
protectedPayments.description: The money is held until the service is completed. The business collects with certainty and the customer pays without fear.

realGuarantees.title: Real guarantees
realGuarantees.description: Escrow deposit, per-service insurance or identity verification: every business chooses how it backs its work, and it is published.

howItWorks.title: How it *works.*
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps, with no blind phone calls and no quotes improvised at the door.

1.title: Describe the problem
1.description: A photo and a couple of details are enough. The AI proposes the diagnosis, the likely materials and a price range.

2.title: Choose a verified business
2.description: Every business shows its validated identity, its guarantee option and its track record. The customer compares and books.

3.title: Pay once the work is done
3.description: The payment is released when the order closes. The service recording stands as evidence if there is a dispute.

metrics.title: The market we are *organizing.*
metrics.subtitle: Figures from the Mexican home maintenance market, not from our own operation.
metrics.households: households in Mexico need maintenance every year
metrics.informality: of the market operates informally, with no guarantee or receipt
metrics.providers: providers ready for launch in Chihuahua

guaranteeTypes.title: Five *guarantee* options.
guaranteeTypes.subtitle: No competitor has a single one. Every business picks its own at sign-up and it stays visible to the customer.

recording.title: Mandatory service recording
recording.description: Every service is recorded from start to finish. If the recording is missing or interrupted, the dispute is resolved in the customer's favor.

deposit.title: Cash deposit
deposit.description: Between $3,000 and $10,000 held in escrow while the business operates on the platform.

insurance.title: Per-service insurance
insurance.description: A policy covering property damage during the visit, taken out service by service.

combined.title: Combined A+B
combined.description: Escrow deposit and per-service insurance at the same time. This is the recommended option.

verification.title: Verification only
verification.description: Government ID, biometrics and background checks validated, with no additional financial backing.

asset.title: Registered asset
asset.description: A registered property or asset stands as formal backing for the business commitment.

pricing.title: Plans for *businesses.*
pricing.subtitle: A monthly subscription plus a per-service commission that drops as your operation grows.

basic.name: Basic
features: Up to 50 products in the catalog

cta.title: Your home, in *good hands.*
cta.subtitle: Register your business today and start taking jobs with guaranteed payment from day one.
